verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV has a first-party reporting page that defines a conversion rate (sessions begun vs. completed), and the Dashboard shows per-session status, so a basic funnel metric exists. Link onEvent callbacks and STEP_UPDATED webhooks are only developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented pass-rate analytics, drop-off-by-step reporting, completion-time metrics, breakdowns by country and document type, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups

citations.quote: The conversion rate is defined as the percentage of sessions begun that were completed, regardless of whether the user passed or failed verification.
You can view the status of any Identity Verification session in the Dashboard.
